forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M4BXT7ZTAKCNYM4N04Z6VJEP
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: Each run with a caller gets the agents tool, with only the message ops when it has no Agent grant
+---
+## What
+Each run that has a caller must get an `agents` tool, so that it can send a message to its caller. The rule is not changed for a run that has an `Agent`, `Agent(a, b)` or `agents` entry and is above the depth limit: it gets the full tool.
+
+A run with a caller but no grant gets the messaging tool. A run at `maxDepth` also gets the messaging tool. The messaging tool has only `send caller` and `send agent`. It has no `list`, `start`, `check` or `cancel` op, in the schema or in the description.
+
+The tool must also know the link to the caller of its run:
+- the `ToolContext` of the `start agent` call in the calling session (`AgentRun.context`);
+- the session id of the caller (`AgentRun.caller`).
+
+Files:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tool/AgentsToolContext.swift`: add `let grant: Grant` (`.full` / `.messagingOnly`) and `let callerLink: CallerLink?` (new `struct CallerLink: Sendable { let call: ToolContext; let sessionID: ULID }`).
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tool/AgentsTool.swift`: `make` selects the op list from `grant`. `.messagingOnly` does not need the catalog to be loaded, and it gives a short description with no agent list.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun.swift` (`agentsTool(of:)` at :200), `Run/AgentRunRequest.swift` (`AgentsToolMaker`), `Run/AgentSessionMaker.swift` (`agentsToolFactory` at :130), `Tools/ToolResolver.swift` (:64-75): pass the caller link. Mount the messaging tool when `request.context != nil` and the run has no grant or is at `maxDepth`.
+- A host-started run (`context == nil`) with no grant gets no tool, as now.
+
+This task adds no new op. `send caller` comes in its own task. Until then, the messaging tool has `send agent` only, and that is correct for a run whose children cannot exist.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A child run with no `Agent` entry has an `agents` tool whose schema `op` enum is exactly the messaging ops.
+- [ ] A child run at `maxDepth` with an `Agent` entry has the messaging tool, not the full tool.
+- [ ] A child run with an `Agent` entry below `maxDepth` has the full tool, and its context has the caller link.
+- [ ] A host-started run with no `Agent` entry has no `agents` tool.
+- [ ] The messaging tool description names no agents and no `start agent`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentsToolMountTests.swift`: the four mount cases above.
+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/NestedRunTests+Limits.swift`: the maxDepth case now expects the messaging tool.
+- [ ] Add a schema test for the messaging grant in `AgentsToolSchemaTests.swift`.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then do the implementation until they pass.
\ No newline at end of file
